package.name: sim_vehicle
package.description: Simulation vehicle node for laser-weeder integration testing without hardware. Replaces gnss_localization (publishes /gnss_driver/pose, /gnss_driver/origin, TF odom->base_link) and the four-wheel-steering chassis (consumes /chassis/cmd, integrates the equivalent Ackermann motion and publishes four wheel steer angles and speeds), and publishes /work_mode so that global_path_planner and path_tracker can be exercised end to end. A C++ orchestrator switches to UNMANNED mode after the planned path becomes available.
